changes.title: Playtest rules
items: Babies join when their area gets a soundsystem; they cannot be invited with letters or conversation.
Wild pursuers follow you across area borders on foot. Take off to end an ordinary chase; hunters stop when you fly outside their area.
Only legends whose quests you completed dance at the final party. The others sleep in their circles.
Friendly legends defend you first, engage nearby enemies, then walk along the ley line towards its growing tip.
On each animal's island, its friendly legend now guards your home area instead of carrying the treehouse.
Legends can dream of a kind anywhere on the map, with no distance cap.
Rhino and unicorn legends now make long charges; ordinary rhinos and unicorns keep their attacks.
Legends now crouch before long charges and stretch into their run.

changes.title: Treehouse points kitchen
items: The layout editor has individually movable numbered hat spawn points, plus the current large cauldron and all nine mushroom baskets.
A separate opt-in preview tries Ed's saved arrangement in play while keeping the published house layout unchanged.

changes.title: Night vision potion
items: Night Vision turns the forest black and green, with a startup whine and only creature sounds. Heat Vision shows cold blue scenery and warm animals, silences music and lowers creature sounds an octave, with quiet mask-like breathing.

changes.title: Hue spin potion
items: Hue Spin makes the forest's colours cycle while its sounds sweep from muffled to bright. Adjust the cycle and sound in the Potion lab.

changes.title: Forest counts potion
items: The Forest Counts makes wind, mist and sound step to the beat while you and the animals move smoothly. Tune its rhythm in the Potion lab.

changes.title: Pause native keys
items: Keys pressed while paused no longer press buttons behind the pause screen.
